name: Sectivia U.S. supply-chain graph
description: 350 mapped supplier-customer relationships between 215 companies (214 U.S.-listed) across 6 sectors.
caveat: Relationships were assembled by hand from company filings, investor presentations, product documentation and industry reporting. Some are stated outright by one of the two parties; others are a reasoned inference from what a company sells and who buys that category. Detailed supplier lists are commercially confidential almost everywhere, so no public map of this kind can be complete or fully sourced. Treat it as a researched starting point, not a register of contracts.

demo_operational_layer.notes: All original JSON values preserved. Added operational fields and relationship descriptions are synthetic. Company JSON exposes parsed arrays without the CSV _json suffix. Original source metadata describes the original graph only, not the added synthetic layer.
demo_operational_layer.importer_requirement: Explicitly accept synthetic_demo; never treat the added records as sourced or independently verified.

model_parameters.path_selection: maximum stress, then shortest depth, then lexical path ID
model_parameters.route_seed: intensity * assumed route_vulnerability * assumed route_shipment_share * (1 - assumed replacement_fraction)
model_parameters.missing_input_policy: Explicit validation error or unknown; never silently zero missing fields.
model_parameters.metric_label: Assumed stress-weighted exposure; not financial loss

assumption_definitions.commercial_generation: SHA-256 UTF-8 42|commercial-v1|<stable_relationship_id>|allocation selects integer 1+(hash mod 4). Allocate budget 0.8 proportionally per customer; sort edges by stable ID; floor to 12 decimal places and give final edge the residual. Replacement hash suffix |replacement selects [0,0.25,0.5] by modulo 3. Effective weight = weight*(1-replacement).
assumption_definitions.operational_generation: Existing seed-42 facilities, geometry and company-scoped assumptions retained without regeneration.
assumption_definitions.operational_share: Assumed facility contribution within synthetic company footprint; sum 1. Measured field remains null.
assumption_definitions.route_shipment_share: Assumed modeled shipment fraction [0,1]; measured dependence_share remains null.
assumption_definitions.replacement_fraction: Assumed replaceable fraction [0,1]. Route values joined by company+route.
assumption_definitions.commercial_topology: dataset_reported; numeric parameters synthetic_demo; no new source edges.

commodity_context.reason: Context-only synthetic links. Commercial source edges remain the sole dependency propagation channel.

import_mapping_metadata.company_arrays: CSV *_json cells decoded once; JSON corresponding arrays omit _json suffix.
import_mapping_metadata.enum_policy: These normalized names are proposed adapter values, not verified application enums. Unknown inputs must produce explicit validation errors.
import_mapping_metadata.source_preservation: Keep raw country, segment, type, measured shares and provenance unchanged. Normalized shares must carry assumed status.
import_mapping_metadata.load_policy: Choose JSON OR CSV pair; replace active dataset atomically by dataset_revision and stable IDs; do not concatenate both sources.
import_mapping_metadata.csv_configuration: Exactly one nonblank demo_configuration_json in the company CSV. Scan all rows and parse once as global configuration, independently of selected company.
